scope: Projection, public access, venue operations, travel planning and availability rules for official Fortnite physical events in France and Europe

architecture.identity_layer: What the physical event is and how it relates to competitions/host events.
architecture.location_layer: Venue, city, address precision, spaces/zones and verified GEO.
architecture.access_layer: Admission mode, registration/check-in, age/ID/re-entry/accessibility and last-entry rules.
architecture.ticketing_layer: Inventory, waitlist, price, session/category availability and scarcity evidence.
architecture.schedule_layer: Public sessions/doors/stand hours distinct from competitive match schedule.
architecture.travel_layer: Planning lead time derived from territory/date only; never fabricates transport/hotel availability.
architecture.onsite_layer: Queue, credential, security and accessibility details only when directly published.

FEATURED: major official Epic/Fortnite activation in France
major EWC/Red Bull/partner event with direct Fortnite program
LEDGER_ONLY: minor partner presence without useful schedule
city/date announcement with no actionable public access yet

planning_readiness.IDENTITY_ONLY: Event exists but date/location/access remain insufficient for planning.
planning_readiness.DATE_CITY_KNOWN: Date and city are known; exact venue or admission path may still be unknown.
planning_readiness.VENUE_KNOWN: Exact venue/building is known but public access path may still be unknown.
planning_readiness.ACCESS_PATH_KNOWN: A real public action exists: ticket, waitlist, attendance registration or explicit free entry.
planning_readiness.PUBLIC_SESSION_KNOWN: At least one actionable public session/doors/stand time is known.
planning_readiness.PUBLIC_INFO_MATURE: Venue, access path and useful public schedule are sufficiently mature for attendance planning.

actions.JOIN_WAITLIST: Official waiting list is the best current access route.
actions.REGISTER_INTEREST: Notify-me/preregistration exists but does not establish admission or attendance registration.
actions.REGISTER_ATTENDANCE: Organizer explicitly requires/opens registration that grants or is required for attendance.
actions.CHECK_IN: A separate explicit check-in action is required and currently actionable.
actions.ATTEND: Free/open access is explicitly established or no further admission action is required at event scope.
actions.VISIT_STAND: Convention/stand has an actionable public schedule/location.
actions.WATCH: Viewing party or spectator session is the primary action.
actions.MEET: Meet-and-greet/session has an actionable access path.
actions.FOLLOW: Physical event is confirmed but no public admission action is yet established.

rules: AVAILABLE_OR_ON_SALE_DIRECT_INVENTORY => BUY_TICKET unless an earlier mandatory CHECK_IN applies now

location_policy.LOCATION: Use venue registry address at best verified precision.
location_policy.GEO: Materialize only when venue registry has verified numeric latitude/longitude and geo_source.
location_policy.structured_location: X-APPLE-STRUCTURED-LOCATION may be added only when address/GEO are verified and the ICS validator accepts the folded property.
location_policy.maps: Directions/maps links may be stored only from a direct venue/organizer or a deterministic map query based on an already verified address; never use a map result to upgrade canonical address precision.
location_policy.venue_change: Same logical event changing venue keeps event UID/physical_event_id, records previous venue in history and increments VEVENT SEQUENCE only if projected LOCATION changes.
location_policy.subspaces: Hall/stand/zone/entrance IDs may be projected only when the venue registry or event source explicitly ties that space to Fortnite.
location_policy.tba_replacement: A CITY-level TBA venue may be replaced by a newly confirmed venue_id without changing physical_event_id/event_uid. Preserve previous location in history.

access_bridge.check_in: Check-in opens/closes only from explicit published windows; event start is never substituted for check-in close.
access_bridge.last_entry: LAST_ENTRY is separate from event/session end and is never inferred from doors/opening time.
access_bridge.accessibility: PMR/companion/accessibility facts may be shown only at the exact scope published; never infer from a venue's general reputation or building type.

ticketing_bridge.global_status: Ticket state never overrides access rules. Derive inventory from ticketing event-level state after considering session/category exceptions.

session_policy.same_run_new_session: Keep same physical_event_id and normally same event_uid; add session and update description/alarms only if actionably useful.
session_policy.session_removed: Require direct evidence or persistent unambiguous removal; a transient page failure does not remove a session.
session_policy.time_conflict: If two projected physical sessions overlap exactly or leave less than 30 minutes turnaround, store a planning conflict. Never automatically choose which event to attend.

travel_scopes.FRANCE_DOMESTIC: France outside the local Paris/IDF scope.

travel_policy.rule: Travel scope changes reminder lead time only. It never claims train, flight, hotel, visa, parking or local transport availability.
travel_policy.major_cross_border: FEATURED + CROSS_BORDER_EU may use P30D planning reminder when still future.
travel_policy.local_exact_time: Paris/IDF exact public session may use H-2 in addition to date reminders.
travel_policy.venue_tba: A venue-TBA event can trigger a city/date planning reminder but should not produce route/entrance instructions.

change_handling.venue_changed: Keep IDs, append previous venue, invalidate obsolete location-specific reminders, rebuild future ones.
change_handling.session_rescheduled: Keep session_id, store previous start/end, invalidate obsolete reminders and recalculate.
change_handling.access_changed: Ticket/access changes do not create a new event; recompute primary_action and only notify if materially actionable.
change_handling.age_or_id_rule_added: Treat as material onsite requirement change for a future CALENDAR/FEATURED event.
change_handling.accessibility_rule_added: Store silently unless it materially affects an explicitly tracked attendance action; do not infer user needs.
change_handling.postponed: Keep IDs and remove obsolete future alarms until a new date is official.
change_handling.cancelled: Keep IDs, STATUS:CANCELLED in projected VEVENT and invalidate all future attendance notices.

reminder_selection.quiet_hours: Nonurgent notices 21:00-09:00 Europe/Paris may be deferred only if still actionable. Ticket back-on-sale, check-in closing soon or last-minute cancellation may notify immediately.

ics_mapping.materialization_guard: Only verified non-UNKNOWN access/onsite fields are written to ICS. Unknown fields remain absent, not serialized as misleading defaults.
ics_mapping.header_only_rule: Do not change SEQUENCE just to add policy headers; materialize on the next real business update.
